report.summary: The board boot-loops: firmware aborts with "assert failed" right after the RGB panel is added to LVGL (LCD shows backlight only), so the dashboard, web UI, MQTT and console never come up.

tests.name: Boot health — no panic / abort / watchdog reset
tests.details: Every boot of build 6d891b034 dies at the same point, immediately after the display panel line, with an 'assert failed' abort followed by a RISC-V register dump and a hardware-style restart (rst:0xc SW_CPU_RESET). The image never reaches app_main's start line, the web UI, MQTT or the console.
tests.evidence:
I (2775) LVGL: Starting LVGL task / I (2795) app_display: Panel 'display_lcd' from board 'esp32_s31_korvo_1': generic_rgb rgb 800x480 / I (2795) LVGL: Stopped LVGL task / I (2835) a
assert failed: 0x2f00c000 / MEPC 0x2f00bae4 RA 0x2f00ba9a MCAUSE 0x2 EXCEPTION / stack: 'assert failed: 0x2f00c000 0x00000000' / ELF file SHA256: 6d891b034 / Rebooting... (repeats)

tests.name: LCD shows the dashboard (four room cards)
tests.details: User observation on the real panel: the backlight comes on but the screen stays black while the board reboots. The frame buffer is initialised (DEV_DISPLAY_LCD logged a successful RGB panel) but LVGL dies before drawing anything.
tests.evidence: User: 'screen displays black / shows backlight and reboots'

tests.name: LVGL display port and RGB panel registered
tests.details: lvgl_port_add_disp_rgb() returns with the panel registered, but the LVGL port tears itself down seconds later. The 'Stopped LVGL task' line is emitted only from the esp_lvgl_port task loop after lvgl_port_ctx.running goes false, i.e. a second lvgl_port_init()/lvgl_port_deinit() ran while the task was already up. Source inspection points at the double bring-up that was believed fixed: app_main calls app_display_init(), and heating_ui_init() calls app_display_init() again (heating_ui.cpp:470). Each call starts a 'display_setup' task that does lvgl_port_init() → add_disp → add_touch; the second lvgl_port_init zeroes the context underneath the running task, which then deinits the mutex/event group/LVGL itself and the next lock/read faults — the same signature the functional run already saw as duplicated 'Display setup started' / panel / touch / 'Display initialized' lines but passed as 'harmless logging'.
tests.evidence: I (2775) LVGL: Starting LVGL task / I (2795) LVGL: Stopped LVGL task / assert failed: 0x2f00c000 / app_display.cpp:64 lvgl_port_init(&port_cfg); heating_ui.cpp:470-471 esp_err_t err = app_display_init(); / esp_lvgl_port.c:216-256 task loop + 'Stopped LVGL task'

tests.name: Boot reaches the application banner / console
tests.details: No 'app_console: Console ready' or 'app_main: ZeroCode AI firmware started' line ever appears; my 'uptime' console commands get no reply and no device-hardware log stream was produced for this session (checks could therefore only rely on the pasted boot log).
tests.evidence: past boot log ends in the abort before app_display/app_webui/app_mqtt/app_console init; send_device_command 'uptime' → no reply landed

tests.name: Status LED strip colours (white connecting → green online)
tests.details: The strip driver binds, but the board never stays up long enough to reach Wi-Fi/broker state, so no colour progression exists to observe.

tests.name: Touch selection / -/+ setpoint, and voice push-to-talk
tests.details: Both need the dashboard that never gets drawn or the voice path that boots but is abandoned at boot; blocked by the abort.

tests.name: MQTT setpoint publish, TRV parsing, permit-join
tests.details: Blocked: app_mqtt_init is never reached on this build.

deviceInfo.chip: ESP32-S31 rev v0.0, 2 cores, 16 MB flash, 16 MB PSRAM
deviceInfo.bootTime: aborts ~2.8 s after reset, before app_main completes; repeats

report.suggestedFix: Remove the second display bring-up: heating_ui_init() must not call app_display_init() again — it should only wait for the display_setup task's panel + touch registration (e.g. poll for the display handle / an 'app_display ready' flag) and then build the screen. Alternatively make app_display_init() idempotent (single task, no second lvgl_port_init) and log the duplicate call. After the fix the boot must show exactly one 'display_setup' pass and no second 'LVGL: Starting LVGL task' / 'Stopped LVGL task', no 'assert failed', and the dashboard must actually paint on the 800x480 RGB panel.
report.notes: Diagnosed from the boot log the user pasted; the live device-hardware log stream was not available for this session, so the console/uptime checks could not be re-run.
